title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 动作驱动的视觉模拟器 WorldLine 介绍

paragraphs.en: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot–object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine , an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at project page .
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界的机器人学习受限于收集经验和评估候选行为的成本。 视频生成模型为视觉模拟器提供了可扩展的基础，能够在物理执行之前预测动作结果。 然而，视频生成模型往往更注重视觉合理性，而非准确的动作跟随和连贯的机器人-物体动力学；而动作条件模拟器则依赖稀缺且与特定本体绑定的数据，这些数据难以在不兼容的控制空间之间共享。 我们提出了 WorldLine，这是一个动作驱动的视觉模拟器，将可迁移的动力学学习与异构的动作落地相解耦。 WorldLine 从超过 10,000 小时的无动作标注机器人视频中学习操作动力学，并利用超过 2,000 小时、来自十多种本体的动作轨迹对其进行落地。 图像空间动作表示提供了跨本体的共享控制接口，而结合关系正则化的多视角和失败增强训练则提升了对交互敏感的预测能力。 面向机器人的少步蒸馏在保留动作关键运动的同时，实现了高效的因果 rollout。 在保留域和域外设置中，WorldLine 保持了出色的视觉质量与机器人运动一致性；在失败轨迹上，相比最强基线，它将机器人掩码 IoU 提升了 0.1626。 在 RoboTwin 和 AgiBot 上，它以 74% 的平均准确率预测轨迹成功，比最强基线高出一个百分点。 在不使用 RoboTwin 训练或适配的情况下，其 rollout 相比直接执行策略最多可将任务成功率提升 21.4 个百分点。 这些能力共同使 WorldLine 成为一个可扩展且高效的视觉模拟器，可用于策略评估和具身规划。 更多结果请见项目主页。

Conventional simulators Todorov et al. (2012) ; Makoviychuk et al. (2021) reduce this burden but require handcrafted assets and dynamics, limiting scalability across environments and embodiments. Video generation models Brooks et al. (2024) ; Wan et al. (2025) offer a data-driven visual prior, but their pretraining objectives primarily emphasize visual realism and temporal consistency without explicitly enforcing faithful responses to robot controls. Action-conditioned visual simulation therefore requires action fidelity : generated trajectories must accurately follow commanded direction, timing, and gripper state while preserving coherent robot–object dynamics over time Guo et al. (2026) ; Agarwal et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026) .

paragraphs.en: We introduce WorldLine , an action-driven visual simulator built on the insight that robot–object dynamics and precise action grounding can be learned separately, allowing dynamics learning to scale beyond scarce action-labeled trajectories. WorldLine first adapts a pretrained video model to more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos to learn a transferable prior over robot motion and object interaction. It then uses over 2,000 hours of action trajectories spanning more than ten robot embodiments to learn how heterogeneous controls drive future motion. Rather than forcing incompatible controls into a common vector space, WorldLine projects their spatial effects, including end-effector pose and gripper state, into each camera view, providing a shared image-space interface that preserves action geometry across embodiments. This action grounding enables predicted motion to faithfully follow commanded actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WorldLine，一个动作驱动的视觉模拟器，其核心洞察是：机器人–物体动力学与精确的动作接地可以分开学习，从而让动力学学习摆脱稀缺的动作标注轨迹的限制、实现规模化。 WorldLine 首先将一个预训练视频模型适配到超过一万小时的无动作机器人视频上，以学习一个关于机器人运动与物体交互的可迁移先验。 然后它利用两千余小时、覆盖十多种机器人本体的动作轨迹，学习异构控制如何驱动未来运动。 WorldLine 并不强行把不兼容的控制塞进一个共同的向量空间，而是将它们的空间效果——包括末端执行器位姿和夹爪状态——投影到各个相机视图中，从而提供一个共享的图像空间接口，在不同本体之间保留动作几何。 这种动作接地使预测的运动能够忠实地跟随所下达的动作。

paragraphs.en: Accurate control following alone is not enough; predictions should also distinguish successful and unsuccessful interaction outcomes. WorldLine uses synchronized multi-view videos to provide complementary observations of robot and object motion, while failure trajectories expose the model to unsuccessful outcomes rather than biasing generation toward successful completion. Relational regularization further promotes temporal and cross-view consistency. Finally, robot-focused few-step distillation turns the model into an efficient causal simulator without sacrificing action-critical motion, enabling policy evaluation and embodied planning.
paragraphs.zh: 仅做到精确的跟随控制是不够的；预测还应能区分成功与失败的交互结果。 WorldLine 利用同步的多视角视频，为智能体和物体运动提供互补的观测，同时失败轨迹让模型接触到失败的结果，而不是使生成偏向于成功完成。 关系正则化进一步促进了时间维度和跨视角的一致性。 最后，面向智能体的少步蒸馏将该模型转变为一个高效的因果模拟器，且不牺牲与动作相关的运动，从而支持策略评估与具身规划。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate WorldLine from three complementary perspectives: action-conditioned video generation, policy evaluation, and embodied planning. For action-conditioned generation, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement across held-out and out-of-domain settings. On failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. For policy evaluation, WorldLine rollouts, evaluated by Qwen3VL-8B using extracted visual evidence and deterministic task-specific rules, achieve 74% mean trajectory-success classification accuracy across RoboTwin Chen et al. (2026) and AgiBot Bu et al. (2025) , compared with 73% for the strongest baselines. For RoboTwin planning, WorldLine is evaluated without RoboTwin training, adaptation, or checkpoint selection. Selecting among policy-generated candidates using WorldLine rollouts and a Qwen3VL-8B selector improves task success at N = 32 N=32 by 19.1 and 21.4 percentage points for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} Black et al. (2025a) and LingBot-VLA Wu et al. (2026a) , respectively, over direct policy execution. Together, these results demonstrate WorldLine’s scalability and practical value for robot evaluation and planning.

paragraphs.en: Video generation for robot learning. Video generation models have supported robot learning through visual prediction, synthetic data generation, and simulation Finn and Levine (2017) ; Dasari et al. (2020) ; Yang et al. (2024) . Existing work uses generated videos to facilitate policy learning and augment training data Wang et al. (2026) ; Zhu et al. (2024) , or to predict the outcomes of candidate actions for planning and policy evaluation. The latter requires generated trajectories to respond accurately to robot controls and preserve coherent robot–object interactions, rather than merely appear visually plausible Guo et al. (2026) ; Quevedo et al. (2026) . WorldLine targets this predictive setting, with an emphasis on scalable dynamics learning and action-faithful simulation.

paragraphs.en: Action conditioning and scalable visual simulation. Existing visual simulators represent robot controls using native action vectors Agarwal et al. (2026) , learned latent actions Ye et al. (2025) ; Bruce et al. (2024) , or spatial conditions Wu et al. (2026c) ; Alzayer et al. (2026) . Native actions provide direct control but are tied to embodiment-specific kinematics and coordinate systems. Latent actions can capture motion from unlabeled videos but require additional grounding before they can represent executable controls. Spatial conditions provide a geometrically aligned interface, but action representation alone does not resolve the data-scaling problem. Existing simulators still rely primarily on limited action-labeled trajectories whose control spaces and interaction distributions vary across embodiments O’Neill et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2026b) . Most methods therefore learn visual dynamics and action semantics jointly from the same trajectories, coupling simulation coverage to available action supervision. WorldLine instead decouples these objectives by learning transferable robot–object dynamics from large-scale action-free videos and subsequently grounding heterogeneous controls through a shared image-space representation. This design allows action-free videos and embodiment-specific action trajectories to provide complementary supervision.

paragraphs.en: Action-free dynamics corpus. We curate more than 10,000 hours of robot videos from six collections, including AgiBotWorld Bu et al. (2025) , RoboCOIN Wu et al. (2025) , the RoboMIND series Wu et al. (2024) ; Hou et al. (2025) , and Galaxea Jiang et al. (2025) . The corpus spans more than ten robot embodiments and over 3,500 manipulation tasks. We retain one primary task-facing view per trajectory because camera viewpoints and the number of available views vary substantially across datasets and robot embodiments. Stage I trains a text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) model conditioned on the initial frame and task text. Although some source datasets provide robot states or action annotations, these signals are not used as model inputs or conditioning in Stage I; thus, action-free refers to the training setup rather than the absence of such annotations in the source data. We filter out static, reset, corrupted, and otherwise uninformative clips. Dataset composition and video-sampling details are provided in Appendix A.1 and Appendix A.2 .

paragraphs.en: Action-grounding corpus. For Stage II, we aggregate over 2,000 hours of action-labeled trajectories across more than ten robot embodiments. Each trajectory provides temporally aligned controls and calibrated camera geometry. We use robot kinematics to project end-effector motion into each camera view and discard samples with invalid calibration, temporal misalignment, or inconsistent projections. The verified trajectories are converted into camera-aligned action maps encoding projected position, depth, Rot6D orientation, and gripper state. We additionally construct a synchronized multi-view subset containing a head camera and up to two wrist cameras, and include approximately 200 hours of failure trajectories to broaden viewpoint and outcome coverage. Action-map construction and multi-view processing are described in Appendix A.3 ; failure-data construction and evaluation separation are detailed in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 动作接地语料库。 对于第二阶段，我们汇总了来自十多种机器人形态、超过2000小时带动作标注的轨迹数据。 每条轨迹都提供时间对齐的控制信号和标定后的相机几何信息。 我们利用机器人运动学将末端执行器的运动投影到每个相机视图中，并丢弃标定无效、时间未对齐或投影不一致的样本。 经验证的轨迹被转换为相机对齐的动作图，编码投影位置、深度、Rot6D朝向和夹爪状态。 我们还构建了一个包含头戴相机和最多两个腕部相机的同步多视角子集，并纳入约200小时的失败轨迹，以拓宽视角和结果覆盖范围。 动作图构建与多视角处理见附录A.3；失败数据构建与评估划分详见附录A.4。

paragraphs.en: Action grounding does not ensure coherent interactions: a single camera may miss gripper–object contact and object motion, while success-heavy data underrepresent failure outcomes. For multi-view training, we use trajectories with synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist views; trajectories missing a required wrist view are excluded from this objective. The views share temporal positions but retain view-specific spatial coordinates through RoPE. Each view receives camera-projected action maps, and the multi-view flow-matching loss is denoted by ℒ FM mv \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}^{\mathrm{mv}} . We apply the same objective to successful and failed trajectories without outcome labels, exposing the model to unsuccessful interaction outcomes. Further construction details are provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 动作接地并不能保证交互的连贯性：单个相机可能无法捕捉到夹爪与物体的接触以及物体的运动，而以成功为主的数据又对失败结果的呈现不足。 对于多视角训练，我们使用具有同步头部、左腕和右腕视角的轨迹；缺少所需腕部视角的轨迹将被排除在该目标之外。 各视角共享时间位置，但通过 RoPE 保留视角特定的空间坐标。 每个视角都会接收相机投影的动作图，多视角流匹配损失记为 ℒ FM mv \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}^{\mathrm{mv}} 。 我们将相同的目标应用于成功和失败的轨迹，而不使用结果标签，使模型接触到不成功的交互结果。 更多构建细节见附录 A 。

paragraphs.en: Stage II generates full trajectories from a fixed action sequence through iterative ODE sampling, preventing online control updates and making repeated rollout costly. We distill it into a block-autoregressive student that accepts new controls at each block and generates the future in four denoising steps. For block b b , 𝐡 b \mathbf{h}_{b} denotes the available causal history and 𝐀 b \mathbf{A}_{b} the action maps for the next block, which spans four latent frames (16 RGB frames). Training proceeds through causal adaptation, trajectory regression, and score-based distribution matching Yin et al. (2024a) .

paragraphs.en: Analysis. Policy evaluation asks whether a rollout conveys task completion, whereas planning must preserve relative distinctions among competing futures. A prediction can therefore retain enough evidence for binary success assessment yet still reverse the ranking of similar candidates. The appendix results suggest this sensitivity depends on the task: few-step rollouts remain useful when outcomes are visually distinguishable, but are less reliable when selection depends on finer differences. Thus, acceleration does not impose a uniform quality loss; it changes which task-relevant cues survive in the rollout. Since the candidate budget is fixed, whether using the saved runtime to evaluate more candidates can offset ranking errors remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 策略评估关注的是一次展开是否传达了任务完成，而规划必须保留相互竞争的未来之间的相对区别。 因此，一次预测可以保留足够的证据用于二元成败判断，却仍然颠倒相似候选之间的排序。 附录结果表明这种敏感性取决于任务：当结果在视觉上可区分时，少步展开仍然有用；而当选择依赖于更细微的差异时，其可靠性较低。 因此，加速并不会带来统一的质量损失；它改变的是哪些任务相关线索能在展开中保留下来。 由于候选预算是固定的，能否利用节省的运行时间来评估更多候选以抵消排序错误，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Data. Under matched total training compute, Table 3 shows that removing action-free data degrades visual quality and planning. Because the compute budget is matched, this points to the corpus’s complementary interaction coverage rather than additional optimization. The visual degradation is more pronounced on held-out AgiBotWorld than on DROID, suggesting that the action-free corpus contributes most directly to visual fidelity in the familiar domain while still supporting robot-motion prediction under domain shift. Head-view-only training further reduces robot-mask overlap, particularly on AgiBotWorld, consistent with wrist views adding close-range contact and object-motion cues. Failure trajectories broaden the observed action-conditioned outcomes beyond successful task completion. Their benefit is policy-dependent: success-only data barely changes π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} performance but lowers LingBot-VLA success by 10.8 points. Since candidate sets are fixed across variants, this suggests that failure coverage changes how well predicted outcomes rank policy proposals, rather than uniformly increasing success across policies.

paragraphs.en: Action encoding and grounding. Replacing image-space action maps with FiLM-injected native action vectors reduces robot IoU, worsens LPIPS, and lowers planning success across both datasets and policies (Table 3 ). Unlike camera-space maps, native vectors do not explicitly associate each control with its projected image location and its resulting visual effect. The consistent degradation therefore suggests that spatial grounding helps the model predict not only plausible motion but also the consequences used to rank candidate actions. Among projection-based encodings, WorldLine outperforms GE-Sim-V2 and Masked Visual Actions under matched RoboTwin training and a 32-rollout budget as shown in Figure 7 . This advantage across both policies indicates that the benefit is not specific to one policy’s action prior.

paragraphs.en: We presented WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that scales dynamics learning beyond scarce action-labeled data by separating action-free pretraining from image-space action grounding. This design learns transferable robot–object dynamics while grounding heterogeneous controls across embodiments and improving action-conditioned robot-motion and outcome prediction. Across held-out and fully out-of-domain settings, WorldLine follows commanded actions, predicts trajectory success, and improves embodied planning through rollout selection. Four-step causal distillation retains these capabilities at substantially lower latency. Thus, action-driven visual simulation can scale across embodiments while remaining useful for downstream robotic decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldLine，一个动作驱动的视觉模拟器，通过将无动作预训练与图像空间动作落地相分离，将动力学学习扩展到稀缺的动作标注数据之外。 这一设计在学习可迁移的机器人—物体动力学的同时，还能将不同本体之间的异构控制进行落地，并改进以动作为条件的机器人运动与结果预测。 在留出测试和完全跨域的设置下，WorldLine 能够遵循指定的动作、预测轨迹成败，并通过滚动推演选择改进具身规划。 四步因果蒸馏在显著更低的延迟下保留了这些能力。 因此，动作驱动的视觉模拟可以跨不同本体进行扩展，同时对下游机器人决策依然有用。

For each trajectory, we select a primary task-facing view, typically a head, top, or front camera that clearly observes the robot workspace. Although some source datasets contain robot states or actions, Stage I does not provide these signals to the model and treats all samples as action-free videos.

sents.en: For each trajectory, we select a primary task-facing view, typically a head, top, or front camera that clearly observes the robot workspace.

sents.en: Although some source datasets contain robot states or actions, Stage I does not provide these signals to the model and treats all samples as action-free videos.
sents.zh: 尽管某些源数据集包含机器人状态或动作，阶段 I 并不向模型提供这些信号，而是将所有样本视为无动作的视频。

paragraphs.en: Stage II uses robot trajectories with sufficiently reliable state or action sequences and camera geometry. Unlike Stage I, it focuses on grounding robot motion through spatial action conditions and jointly processes synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist observations when all required views are available.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段使用具有足够可靠的状态或动作序列的机器人轨迹以及相机几何信息。 与第一阶段不同，它侧重于通过空间动作条件将机器人运动落地化，并在所有所需视角可用时，联合处理同步的头部、左腕和右腕观测数据。

sents.en: Stage II uses robot trajectories with sufficiently reliable state or action sequences and camera geometry.
sents.zh: 第二阶段使用具有足够可靠的状态或动作序列的机器人轨迹以及相机几何信息。

sents.en: Unlike Stage I, it focuses on grounding robot motion through spatial action conditions and jointly processes synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist observations when all required views are available.
sents.zh: 与第一阶段不同，它侧重于通过空间动作条件将机器人运动落地化，并在所有所需视角可用时，联合处理同步的头部、左腕和右腕观测数据。

paragraphs.en: Training clips are sampled dynamically from valid trajectory segments rather than being pre-segmented into fixed, non-overlapping clips. The sampled clips contain between 33 and 129 frames, allowing the model to observe interactions at different temporal scales. Stage I uses a larger temporal stride to cover longer motion, whereas Stage II samples more densely to preserve fine-grained action effects.
paragraphs.zh: 训练片段是从有效的轨迹段中动态采样的，而不是预先分割成固定的、不重叠的片段。 采样得到的片段包含 33 到 129 帧不等，使模型能够观察不同时间尺度上的交互。 第一阶段使用较大的时间步长以覆盖更长的运动，而第二阶段则更密集地采样以保留细粒度的动作效果。

paragraphs.en: Following Figure 2 , we apply source-specific motion and video-quality criteria to remove static, corrupted, and chassis-motion-dominated clips. Videos are resized to source-specific training resolutions, with camera intrinsics adjusted accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 参照图2，我们采用针对各来源的运动与视频质量标准，剔除静态、损坏以及底盘运动主导的视频片段。 视频被调整为各来源对应的训练分辨率，同时相应地调整相机内参。

sents.en: Following Figure 2 , we apply source-specific motion and video-quality criteria to remove static, corrupted, and chassis-motion-dominated clips.
sents.zh: 参照图2，我们采用针对各来源的运动与视频质量标准，剔除静态、损坏以及底盘运动主导的视频片段。

sents.en: Videos are resized to source-specific training resolutions, with camera intrinsics adjusted accordingly.
sents.zh: 视频被调整为各来源对应的训练分辨率，同时相应地调整相机内参。

paragraphs.en: For Stage II, we retain trajectories that pass calibration validation and projection-consistency filtering, as summarized in Figure 2 . Visual observations and controls are aligned by frame index, and forward kinematics transforms each end-effector pose into the corresponding camera frame. The projected position defines a Gaussian spatial condition that also encodes depth, Rot6D orientation, and gripper state, producing the nine-channel action representation described in the main paper. Invalid or out-of-view projections are masked, and wrist-camera poses are updated from robot kinematics when dynamic extrinsics are available.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第二阶段，我们保留通过标定验证和投影一致性筛选的轨迹，如图 2 所总结。 视觉观测与控制量按帧索引对齐，并通过正向运动学将每个末端执行器位姿变换到相应的相机坐标系。 投影位置定义了一个高斯空间条件，该条件同时编码深度、Rot6D 朝向和夹爪状态，从而生成正文中所述的九通道动作表示。 无效或超出视野的投影会被掩蔽，并且当动态外参可用时，腕部相机的位姿会根据机器人运动学进行更新。

sents.zh: 对于第二阶段，我们保留通过标定验证和投影一致性筛选的轨迹，如图 2 所总结。

paragraphs.en: Stage II uses three semantic camera slots corresponding to the head or top camera, left wrist, and right wrist. All views within a trajectory share the same sampled frame indices and clip length. Trajectories missing a required wrist view are excluded from multi-view training rather than automatically converted into single-view samples.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段使用三个语义相机槽位，分别对应头部或顶部相机、左腕和右腕。 同一条轨迹内的所有视图共享相同的采样帧索引和片段长度。 缺少所需腕部视图的轨迹会被排除在多视图训练之外，而不是被自动转换为单视图样本。

sents.zh: 第二阶段使用三个语义相机槽位，分别对应头部或顶部相机、左腕和右腕。

paragraphs.en: Failure trajectory construction. In addition to successful demonstrations, we construct a dedicated failure dataset by collecting controlled robot executions that do not successfully complete the intended manipulation task. These trajectories capture diverse unsuccessful interactions, such as missed grasps, object slippage, unintended collisions, and incomplete manipulation. We retain the corresponding multi-view observations, robot states or actions, and camera geometry, and process them using the same temporal sampling and action-grounding pipeline as the remaining Stage-II data. During training, failure trajectories are treated as ordinary action–video pairs without providing explicit outcome labels. The simulator must therefore learn the visual consequences of unsuccessful actions directly from the observed trajectories rather than from a predefined failure category.
paragraphs.zh: 失败轨迹构建。 除了成功示例外，我们还通过收集未能成功完成预期操作任务的受控机器人执行过程，构建了一个专门的失败数据集。 这些轨迹捕获了多样的失败交互，例如抓取失败、物体滑落、意外碰撞以及不完整的操作。 我们保留了相应的多视角观测、机器人状态或动作以及相机几何信息，并使用与其余第二阶段数据相同的时间采样和动作对齐流程进行处理。 在训练过程中，失败轨迹被视为普通的动作-视频对，不提供显式的结果标签。 因此，模拟器必须直接从观测到的轨迹中学习失败动作的视觉后果，而不是从预定义的失败类别中学习。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation separation. For evaluation, we construct a scene-disjoint AgiBotWorld split such that the evaluation scenes and their associated trajectories are excluded from training. DROID is not used in any WorldLine training stage, model adaptation, or checkpoint selection. We directly evaluate the standard WorldLine checkpoint on DROID. Compared with the predominantly bimanual training data, DROID contains substantially different camera viewpoints and single-arm manipulation settings, providing an out-of-distribution evaluation of viewpoint and embodiment-configuration generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 评估分离。 在评估方面，我们构建了一个场景不相交的 AgiBotWorld 划分，使评估场景及其关联的轨迹被排除在训练之外。 DROID 未用于任何 WorldLine 训练阶段、模型适配或检查点选择。 我们直接在 DROID 上评估标准的 WorldLine 检查点。 与以双手操作为主的训练数据相比，DROID 包含差异显著的相机视角和单臂操作设置，为视角与智能体构型泛化提供了分布外评估。

paragraphs.en: WorldLine is built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano video generation model. All existing model components are initialized from pretrained weights. Stage I performs full-parameter training on the action-free robot video corpus. The model is conditioned on the initial observation and task description and is optimized using the flow-matching objective described in the main paper. This stage adapts the pretrained video prior to robot motion and manipulation dynamics without consuming robot actions.
paragraphs.zh: WorldLine 基于预训练的 Cosmos3-Nano 视频生成模型构建。 所有现有模型组件均从预训练权重初始化。 阶段 I 在无动作的机器人视频语料库上进行全参数训练。 该模型以初始观测和任务描述为条件，并使用主论文中描述的流匹配目标进行优化。 该阶段在不消耗机器人动作的情况下，将预训练的视频先验适配到机器人运动与操作动力学上。

sents.en: WorldLine is built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano video generation model.
sents.zh: WorldLine 基于预训练的 Cosmos3-Nano 视频生成模型构建。

sents.en: All existing model components are initialized from pretrained weights.
sents.zh: 所有现有模型组件均从预训练权重初始化。

sents.en: Stage I performs full-parameter training on the action-free robot video corpus.
sents.zh: 阶段 I 在无动作的机器人视频语料库上进行全参数训练。

sents.en: The model is conditioned on the initial observation and task description and is optimized using the flow-matching objective described in the main paper.
sents.zh: 该模型以初始观测和任务描述为条件，并使用主论文中描述的流匹配目标进行优化。

sents.en: This stage adapts the pretrained video prior to robot motion and manipulation dynamics without consuming robot actions.
sents.zh: 该阶段在不消耗机器人动作的情况下，将预训练的视频先验适配到机器人运动与操作动力学上。

paragraphs.en: Stage II is initialized from the Stage-I model and removes task-text conditioning. All existing modules inherit their weights from the preceding checkpoint, while the newly introduced action-conditioning branch is zero-initialized. The zero initialization preserves the behavior of the action-free model at the beginning of post-training and allows action control to be introduced progressively.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段从第一阶段的模型初始化，并移除任务文本条件。 所有现有模块均从上一个检查点继承权重，而新引入的动作条件分支采用零初始化。 零初始化在后训练开始时保留了无动作模型的行为，并允许逐步引入动作控制。

sents.en: Stage II is initialized from the Stage-I model and removes task-text conditioning.
sents.zh: 第二阶段从第一阶段的模型初始化，并移除任务文本条件。

sents.en: All existing modules inherit their weights from the preceding checkpoint, while the newly introduced action-conditioning branch is zero-initialized.
sents.zh: 所有现有模块均从上一个检查点继承权重，而新引入的动作条件分支采用零初始化。

sents.en: The zero initialization preserves the behavior of the action-free model at the beginning of post-training and allows action control to be introduced progressively.
sents.zh: 零初始化在后训练开始时保留了无动作模型的行为，并允许逐步引入动作控制。

paragraphs.en: For each view, the nine-channel action maps are rendered directly at the video latent resolution. For a 480 × 640 480\times 640 input, the corresponding action tensor has shape 9 × T ℓ × 30 × 40 9\times T_{\ell}\times 30\times 40 . We use a fixed Gaussian bandwidth of σ g = 10 \sigma_{g}=10 pixels on the 384 × 512 384\times 512 reference canvas. The action encoder applies a single Conv3D ⁡ ( 9 , 9 ) \operatorname{Conv3D}(9,9) layer with a 1 × 3 × 3 1\times 3\times 3 kernel and adds its output to the input action maps. The resulting representation is spatially patchified using 2 × 2 2\times 2 patches and projected from 36 to 4096 dimensions. The action tokens are then added to the spatially and temporally aligned video tokens before the first DiT block. No numerical-action FiLM modulation is used.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个视图，九通道动作图直接以视频潜变量分辨率进行渲染。 对于 480 × 640 480\times 640 的输入，对应的动作张量形状为 9 × T ℓ × 30 × 40 9\times T_{\ell}\times 30\times 40 。 我们在 384 × 512 384\times 512 的参考画布上使用固定的高斯带宽 σ g = 10 \sigma_{g}=10 像素。 动作编码器应用一个带有 1 × 3 × 3 1\times 3\times 3 卷积核的 Conv3D ⁡ ( 9 , 9 ) \operatorname{Conv3D}(9,9) 单层，并将其输出加到输入动作图上。 得到的表示使用 2 × 2 2\times 2 的图块进行空间上的分块处理，并从 36 维投影到 4096 维。 然后在第一个 DiT 块之前，将动作令牌加到空间和时间上对齐的视频令牌中。 未使用数值动作的 FiLM 调制。

sents.en: The action tokens are then added to the spatially and temporally aligned video tokens before the first DiT block.
sents.zh: 然后在第一个 DiT 块之前，将动作令牌加到空间和时间上对齐的视频令牌中。

paragraphs.en: The three camera views are ordered as head, left wrist, and right wrist. They share the same temporal coordinates, while their RoPE height coordinates begin at fixed semantic slots of 0, 480, and 992, respectively. During Stage II, we optimize the generation-specific MoE modules, time embeddings, video-latent input and output projections, and the action-conditioning branch, while keeping the remaining pretrained components fixed. We use AdamW with betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , weight decay 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and a base learning rate of 1.5 × 10 − 5 1.5\times 10^{-5} . The newly initialized action branch uses a 66-times learning-rate multiplier. Training uses a per-device batch size of one, gradient accumulation of two, and gradient clipping at 0.2.
paragraphs.zh: 三个相机视角的顺序为头部、左腕和右腕。 它们共享相同的时间坐标，而其 RoPE 高度坐标分别从固定语义槽位 0、480 和 992 开始。 在第二阶段（Stage II）中，我们优化生成专用的 MoE 模块、时间嵌入、视频潜变量输入与输出投影以及动作条件分支，同时保持其余预训练组件固定。 我们使用 AdamW，其中 betas 为 (0.9, 0.95)，权重衰减为 10^-6，基础学习率为 1.5×10^-5。 新初始化的动作分支使用 66 倍的学习率乘数。 训练时每个设备的批大小为 1，梯度累积为 2，梯度裁剪阈值为 0.2。

sents.zh: 我们使用 AdamW，其中 betas 为 (0.9, 0.95)，权重衰减为 10^-6，基础学习率为 1.5×10^-5。

sents.en: The newly initialized action branch uses a 66-times learning-rate multiplier.

sents.zh: 训练时每个设备的批大小为 1，梯度累积为 2，梯度裁剪阈值为 0.2。

paragraphs.en: We use a frozen V-JEPA2 ViT-g/384 encoder as the relational teacher. We choose V-JEPA2 because its self-supervised representations capture semantic motion and interaction structure beyond low-level pixel similarity, providing stable targets for modeling robot–object dynamics without requiring additional annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用冻结的 V-JEPA2 ViT-g/384 编码器作为关系教师。 我们选择 V-JEPA2 是因为其自监督表征能够捕捉超越低层像素相似性的语义运动与交互结构，从而在无需额外标注的情况下，为建模机器人—物体动力学提供稳定的目标。

sents.en: We use a frozen V-JEPA2 ViT-g/384 encoder as the relational teacher.
sents.zh: 我们使用冻结的 V-JEPA2 ViT-g/384 编码器作为关系教师。

sents.en: We choose V-JEPA2 because its self-supervised representations capture semantic motion and interaction structure beyond low-level pixel similarity, providing stable targets for modeling robot–object dynamics without requiring additional annotations.
sents.zh: 我们选择 V-JEPA2 是因为其自监督表征能够捕捉超越低层像素相似性的语义运动与交互结构，从而在无需额外标注的情况下，为建模机器人—物体动力学提供稳定的目标。

paragraphs.en: Teacher features are obtained by concatenating the normalized outputs of its last four Transformer blocks. Student features are extracted from the output of the 18th DiT block. Because the teacher and student have different feature dimensions, we do not directly regress their feature values. Instead, both representations are temporally aggregated into eight bins and spatially pooled to an 8 × 8 8\times 8 grid. Relational supervision is then applied to their cosine-similarity matrices.
paragraphs.zh: 教师特征由其最后四个 Transformer 块的归一化输出拼接而成。 学生特征从第 18 个 DiT 块的输出中提取。 由于教师和学生的特征维度不同，我们不直接对其特征值进行回归。 相反，两种表示先在时间上聚合为八个区间，再在空间上池化为 8 × 8 8\times 8 的网格。 然后在其余弦相似度矩阵上施加关系监督。

paragraphs.en: The intra-view objective aligns token relations between adjacent temporal bins within the same camera view. At each optimization step, one of the head, left-wrist, and right-wrist views is selected in a round-robin manner. The cross-view objective aligns the head view with one wrist view and alternates between the left and right wrists.

paragraphs.en: We first introduce causal attention and block-wise generation while retaining the Stage-II flow-matching objective. Given the temporal compression ratio of the video tokenizer, each generated block corresponds to 16 RGB frames. paragraphs.en: After each block is generated, its clean key-value features are inserted into the causal cache. The next block is initialized from independent Gaussian noise, while temporal continuity is maintained through the cached history rather than by repeating the final frame of the previous block. For long-horizon rollout, the cache retains one persistent sink block and the three most recent generated blocks. This fixed four-block history bounds memory and computation as the generated sequence becomes longer. The three camera views are generated jointly within each block.
paragraphs.zh: 每个块生成后，其干净的关键-值特征会被插入因果缓存中。 下一个块从独立的高斯噪声初始化，而时间连续性通过缓存的历史来维持，而不是通过重复上一个块的最后一帧来维持。 对于长时程生成，缓存保留一个持久性的汇块以及最近生成的三个块。 这种固定的四块历史在生成序列变长时限制了内存和计算量。 三个相机视角在每个块内联合生成。

paragraphs.en: Stage-II WorldLine uses 35 denoising steps, whereas Causal WorldLine uses four steps for each generated block. paragraphs.en: A 129-frame rollout consists of one observed initial frame followed by eight generated blocks. Latency is measured end-to-end on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU using FP16 precision and batch size one. The measurement includes VAE encoding, video generation, and VAE decoding, while excluding MP4 encoding and disk writing. Stage-II WorldLine requires 90 seconds for a 129-frame rollout, corresponding to 0.698 seconds per frame. Causal WorldLine requires 21 seconds, corresponding to 0.163 seconds per frame and a 4.3 × 4.3\times speedup.

paragraphs.en: Policies and tasks. We evaluate embodied planning in RoboTwin using one fixed checkpoint of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and one fixed checkpoint of LingBot-VLA, each trained on RoboTwin. In contrast, WorldLine is directly evaluated in RoboTwin without using any RoboTwin data for training, adaptation, or checkpoint selection. The policy checkpoints are held fixed across all simulators and rollout budgets. They are not required to represent fully converged policy performance because the purpose of this experiment is to measure the relative improvement obtained from simulator-based trajectory selection over direct execution of the same policy. We evaluate 10 manipulation tasks with five scenes per task.

paragraphs.en: Candidate generation. For each task and scene, a policy generates a bank of up to 32 candidate action trajectories. Every simulator receives the same initial observation and candidate actions. WorldLine renders each candidate as a predicted video. We sample 16 frames from each video: ten frames are distributed over the complete trajectory, while six additional frames are distributed over its final 40%. This sampling preserves the overall action progression while providing denser evidence for placement, release, object dropping, and terminal-state evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 候选生成。 针对每个任务和场景，策略会生成一组最多 32 条候选动作轨迹的候选库。 每个模拟器都接收相同的初始观测和候选动作。 WorldLine 将每个候选渲染为一段预测视频。 我们从每段视频中采样 16 帧：其中十帧分布在完整轨迹上，另外六帧分布在其最后 40% 的区间内。 这种采样方式在保留整体动作进程的同时，为放置、释放、物体掉落以及终止状态评估提供了更密集的证据。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical candidate selection. We use Qwen3VL-8B to select one trajectory from each candidate bank. Candidate identities are hidden from the model and replaced with temporary letter labels. The candidate ordering is deterministically shuffled for each scene. For the 32-candidate setting, candidates are processed using a hierarchical bracket: Qwen3VL-8B selects two candidates from each group of four, progressively reducing the bank from 32 to 16, from 16 to 8, and from 8 to 4. The four finalists are then scored independently from 0 to 100 according to their predicted likelihood of completing the task. The highest-scoring candidate is selected. Tied finalists are compared again using anonymous labels.
paragraphs.zh: 分层候选选择。 我们使用 Qwen3VL-8B 从每个候选库中选择一条轨迹。 候选对象的身份对模型隐藏，并被替换为临时字母标签。 候选对象的顺序在每个场景中被确定性地打乱。 在32候选设置中，候选对象通过分层淘汰结构进行处理：Qwen3VL-8B 从每组四个候选中选出两个，使候选库从32逐步缩减到16，再从16缩减到8，最后从8缩减到4。 随后对四个入围候选进行独立打分，分数范围为0到100，依据是其完成任务的可能性预测。 得分最高的候选被选中。 得分相同的入围候选将使用匿名标签再次进行比较。

paragraphs.en: This schedule allocates more observations to the latter part of the trajectory, where task completion and failure are typically more distinguishable. For multi-view trajectories, all views are sampled at the same normalized positions. The sampled images are resized to a height of 360 pixels. For grasp tasks, synchronized views from the same time step are concatenated horizontally. For lift and state-change tasks, synchronized views are provided as separate image inputs in temporal order.
paragraphs.zh: 该调度策略将更多的观测分配到轨迹的后半部分，因为在这一阶段任务完成与失败通常更容易区分。 对于多视角轨迹，所有视角均在相同的归一化位置进行采样。 采样得到的图像会被调整为高度 360 像素。 对于抓取任务，来自同一时间步的同步视角会被水平拼接。 对于抬升和状态变化任务，同步视角按时间顺序作为独立的图像输入提供。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-based trajectory evaluation. Instructions are routed into three task families: grasp, lift, and state change. Qwen3VL-8B is instructed to extract observable evidence rather than directly predict success or failure. In particular, wrist-camera motion alone is not treated as evidence of object displacement; object motion must be verified in the head view or through clear geometric separation from its support.
paragraphs.zh: 基于证据的轨迹评估。 指令被路由到三个任务族：抓取、抬起和状态改变。 Qwen3VL-8B 被指示提取可观察的证据，而不是直接预测成功或失败。 特别地，仅凭腕部相机的运动不被视为物体位移的证据；物体运动必须在头部视角中得到验证，或通过与支撑物之间清晰的几何分离来确认。

paragraphs.en: Analysis. The task-level results show that the aggregate planning gains are not driven by a single interaction type. For π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , WorldLine increases the average success rate over the five selected tasks from 53.3% under direct execution to 77.6%, a gain of 24.3 percentage points. The largest improvements occur on Handover Block and Stack Two Blocks, where success increases by 48.5 and 54.5 points, respectively. For LingBot-VLA, WorldLine improves the subset average from 26.4% to 48.0% (+21.6 points), with particularly large gains on Open Laptop (+42.5 points) and Handover Block (+30.0 points). These improvements span object transfer, articulated-object manipulation, and multi-object stacking, supporting the use of predicted outcomes for candidate selection across distinct interaction patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 任务级结果表明，总体规划收益并非由单一交互类型驱动。 对于 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}，WorldLine 将五个选定任务的平均成功率从直接执行下的 53.3% 提升至 77.6%，提升了 24.3 个百分点。 最大的改进出现在 Handover Block 和 Stack Two Blocks 上，成功率分别提高了 48.5 和 54.5 个百分点。 对于 LingBot-VLA，WorldLine 将该子集的平均成功率从 26.4% 提升至 48.0%（+21.6 个百分点），其中在 Open Laptop（+42.5 个百分点）和 Handover Block（+30.0 个百分点）上的提升尤为显著。 这些改进涵盖了物体搬运、铰接物体操作和多物体堆叠，支持在不同交互模式下使用预测结果进行候选选择。

paragraphs.en: The causal four-step variant retains substantial average gains over direct execution, reaching 65.6% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 44.0% for LingBot-VLA. paragraphs.en: Although WorldLine generalizes across unseen scenes, environments, and robot embodiments, its coverage is still shaped by the diversity of interactions in the training data. Rare manipulation patterns, deformable objects, unusual camera configurations, and substantially longer action horizons may benefit from broader and more targeted supervision. In downstream planning, the achievable improvement is also bounded by the diversity of trajectories proposed by the underlying policy and the quality of the multimodal selector.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 WorldLine 能够在未见过的场景、环境和机器人本体之间泛化，但其覆盖范围仍受训练数据中交互多样性的制约。 罕见的操作模式、可变形物体、不常见的相机配置以及明显更长的动作时程，都可能受益于更广泛、更有针对性的监督。 在下游规划中，可实现的改进还受底层策略提出的轨迹多样性以及多模态选择器质量的限制。

paragraphs.en: WorldLine can reduce the amount of repeated physical interaction required for robot policy development by enabling candidate behaviors to be visualized, evaluated, and selected before execution. This capability may lower data collection costs, reduce hardware wear, support failure analysis, and make cross-embodiment robot learning more accessible.
paragraphs.zh: WorldLine 通过在执行之前对候选行为进行可视化、评估和选择，能够减少机器人策略开发所需的重复物理交互量。 这一能力可以降低数据收集成本、减少硬件损耗、支持故障分析，并使跨本体机器人学习更容易实现。
